verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for a SaaS work-management product like Jira, but nothing in the evidence pack documents retention policies, deletion controls, or data lifecycle settings. Generic items such as 'Global and project-level configuration' and SAML/SSO are adjacent features, and community reports of losing data are not user-controlled deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
